wake.speaker: The Void
wake.text: So. Another [shake]spark[/shake] falls into the dark.

warn.speaker: The Void
warn.text: The ink down here remembers everything. Will you use it?

choices.text: I will draw my own path.
I want no part of this.
(3 coins) Offer the shards you carry.

brave.speaker: The Void
brave.text: Good. [glitch]Draw[/glitch], little light. The descent is long.

refuse.speaker: The Void
refuse.text: There is no path back up. Only [whisper]down[/whisper].
